biological_support.statistical_interpretation: C0001 shows a coherent, FDR-supported RNA signal (21/50 pathways) with moderate-to-large standardized mean differences (|SMD| 0.73-0.86) and a coherent CNV pattern of 9p/9q/CDKN2A/JAK2/PTEN copy-number decrease with 12/49 continuous features significant and CDKN2A loss and chr20q gain significant in the gain/loss analysis. WXS shows no feature surviving FDR (min q=0.116), though PBRM1 enrichment has a Fisher p of 0.0053 with a CI excluding 1; this is a nominal, non-FDR-supported trend. The RNA and CNV modalities are internally coherent (both point to a distinct transcriptional and copy-number profile), while WXS is weaker and not FDR-significant.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The RNA and CNV findings indicate that C0001 differs from the remaining samples in transcriptional programs (mesenchymal, DNA repair, heme/fatty-acid metabolism) and in copy-number at 9p/9q/CDKN2A/JAK2/PTEN. These are descriptive molecular differences; no prognostic or mechanistic inference is drawn. The PBRM1 mutation enrichment is a nominal trend only.
limitations: WXS enrichment does not survive FDR; PBRM1 and DST findings are nominal.
CNV gain/loss findings for PTEN, chr9q, JAK2, chr9p are near-threshold (q 0.066-0.081).
Effect sizes are moderate; no independent validation.

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: C0002 shows a coherent RNA signal (6/50 pathways, |SMD| 0.62-0.96), a single FDR-significant WXS finding (PBRM1, q=0.033), and a strong CNV signal (18/49 continuous features significant, |delta| 0.56-0.64, all lower in set) with two significant gain/loss depletions (chr14q, chr8p loss). biological_support.medical_interpretation: C0002 differs from the remaining samples in transcriptional programs (beta-cell, IL6/JAK-STAT3, allograft rejection, heme metabolism), in PBRM1 mutation frequency, and in copy-number at chr12p/VHL/chr20q/BAP1/SETD2 and chr14q/chr8p. These are descriptive molecular differences; no prognostic or mechanistic inference is drawn.
limitations: WXS is limited to one FDR-significant gene; VHL and BAP1 differences are not significant.
